title: China&\#x27;s Q/V-band wireless link reaches 27 Gbps bidirectional
summary: Researchers from the Chinese Academy of Sciences&\#x27; Aerospace Information Research Institute and partner institutions completed a Q/V-band bidirectional wireless communication experiment at the Lijiang China Remote Sensing Satellite Ground Station, reporting a domestic record of 27 Gbps. The test covered 64QAM through 512QAM; at 512QAM a single channel reached 6.75 Gbps bidirectional, and dual carriers plus polarization multiplexing raised the aggregate bidirectional rate to 27 Gbps. The team described the key indicators as domestically leading and internationally advanced and said it aims to exceed 50 Gbps. The report did not provide link distance, bandwidth, spectral efficiency, or peer-reviewed detail, and the result is a validation rather than a deployed service.
